notes.title: South of Midnight is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44236943/306daaf6a7d25c36480f02b9b90b30197038e043.png[/img]

Today, we announced that South of Midnight is officially Steam Deck Verified! Here’s what you can expect:
[list]
[*] All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configuration
[*] This game shows Steam Deck controller icons
[*] In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
[*] This game's default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck
[/list][i][b]Disclaimer:[/b] This game does not default to external Bluetooth/USB controllers on Deck, and may require switching the active controller via the Quick Access Menu.[/i]

For an optimal experience, we playtested and tuned the settings for the Steam Deck specifically. Please note that in our pre-launch testing, the game consistently runs above [b]30 FPS[/b] on the Steam Deck in medium quality and in the standard resolution of the device ([b]800p[/b]). We recommend turning on the 30 FPS frame limiter (in the graphical options) for a more consistent interactive experience during play, but we chose to leave it off by default for those of you who would prefer getting reduced latency during combat encounters or plan to play your Steam Deck while using a power outlet.

- The Compulsion Dev Team
